reason: This is a lot of money from a property sale and I'd never move it on the strength of an ad. My cousin in India already handles things and my community accountant knows my file, so a stranger company has to beat that, and I can't tell from this page that it does.
objection: What if the transfer gets stuck halfway or the CA rejects something? A refund of their fee doesn't help if my lakhs are sitting in limbo and I'm chasing people across two countries.
would_change_my_mind: My own accountant checking them out and confirming the FINTRAC registration and the partner bank, plus a few people from my community who moved a similar lump sum with them. A small test transfer first would also help.
